title: C676 — RH mirror BLIS / CTA LED connector
introduction:
This reference identifies the right-hand (RH) exterior mirror LED for blind spot (BLIS) / cross traffic alert (CTA). I start with the connector identity table, then match the drawing's cavity labels to the Cavity column. Think of the map as the warning light's mailing address: it tells you where each connection belongs, without confirming that the message arrives.
